name: Zambia

flag.description: A green field with a block of three vertical stripes, red, black and orange, in the lower fly, beneath an orange eagle in flight.
flag.symbolism: Green represents natural resources, red the struggle for freedom, black the people and orange the country's mineral wealth, especially copper; the eagle represents rising above the nation's problems.

hook: Zambia puts all its action in the fly corner: an orange fish eagle soaring over red, black and orange stripes on a green field.
trivia: The eagle is an African fish eagle, the national bird.
Zambia shares Victoria Falls, locally Mosi-oa-Tunya, 'the smoke that thunders', with Zimbabwe.
